blocks.text: New listings in Abbotsford come on the MLS® every day. This search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less, live. To judge a fresh listing, it helps to know how quickly the market is clearing: in October 2026, 72 detached homes and 89 condos and townhomes sold in Abbotsford, and the typical detached home sold in 38 days.
How fast Abbotsford homes sold over the past year

Detached sales in Abbotsford peaked at 72 in October 2026 and were lowest at 30 in January 2026. Active detached listings moved between 293 and 469 over the same 13 months. In October 2026 the median detached sale price was $1,060,000, which is 0% above October 2025.

blocks.text: How fast new Abbotsford listings sell

A new listing’s first days matter most where homes sell quickly. Over the past year the fastest-selling Abbotsford groups (median days to sell, at least 10 sales) were Abbotsford East condos (13 days, 19 sales), Abbotsford West houses (19 days, 118 sales), Poplar houses (21 days, 18 sales). The slowest were Central Abbotsford condos (36 days), Poplar townhomes (35 days), Abbotsford West condos (35 days).

blocks.text: How long a new Abbotsford listing may sit

Months of supply is the number of months it would take to sell today's listings at the current pace. For Abbotsford detached homes it was 5.7 months in October 2026 and for condos and townhomes 6.1. The fastest detached price ranges were $800,001 to $900,000 (35% sales ratio on 13 sales); $900,001 to $1,000,000 (22% sales ratio on 13 sales); $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 (19% sales ratio on 23 sales). For condos and townhomes the quickest were $200,001 to $300,000 (24%) and $600,001 to $700,000 (20%).

By area, new detached listings met the strongest demand in Aberdeen (30%), Abbotsford East (23%), Abbotsford West (18%). The areas with the most stock relative to sales were Central Abbotsford (8%), Abbotsford West (18%), Abbotsford East (23%), so a fresh listing there is likely to have company.

Compared with October 2025, October 2026 had 13% fewer detached homes for sale in Abbotsford and 33% more detached sales. Condos and townhomes had 5% fewer for sale and 11% fewer sales. The detached sale price moved 0% up and the condo and townhome price 17% down.
